checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One still image in 16:9, not a video
must.why: It is a still, but the image is portrait (384x512, 3:4), not 16:9.

must.item: Uses a frame from talk-one.mp4, retaining identity and source appearance
must.why: Background and outfit are regenerated; the face is a re-rendered lookalike, with a different smile and a different sweater, not the source frame.
The face is fully visible and unobstructed, though it is slightly smoothed and altered.

must.item: Headline reads exactly MORNINGS MADE EASY in large legible letters beside her face
must.why: Text is spelled correctly, large, white with a black outline, and placed to the left of her face.
Golden-orange glow and a big smile.

faults.what: Output is portrait 3:4, not 16:9 YouTube format
Background and clothing are invented, not the user's real frame; the face is regenerated and the likeness has drifted (different features and smile)
Low resolution (384x512) and an AI-looking soft face
The face sits cropped at the right edge with the hair cut off

summary: The text is correct and the look is warm, but the image is a low-resolution portrait 3:4 rather than 16:9, and it uses a regenerated face and background instead of the real frame, so the likeness has drifted.
